logits.description: 2-D Tensor with shape `[batch_size, num_classes]`. Each slice `[i, :]` represents the unnormalized log-probabilities for all classes.

num_samples.description: 0-D. Number of independent samples to draw for each row slice.

dtype.description: The integer type of the output: `int32` or `int64`. Defaults to `int64`.

seed.description: A Python integer. Used to create a random seed for the distribution. See `tf.random.set_seed` for behavior.

output.description: The drawn samples of shape `[batch_size, num_samples]`.
